A few weeks ago I was feeling sick, and I thought maybe it was as a result of needing some fruits and vegetables, or perhaps due to lack of exercise (on top of the fact that I had just finished something very stressful, and oftentimes I get sick after the end of periods of stress, I guess because when the pressure is off all the strain catches up to me). Figuring it would be a good plan either way, I went to walk to a restaurant to get something with some veggies in it and a juice or something to go with it.

As I walked to the restaurant, for whatever reason, my mind wandered to the girl I had taken to prom my junior year of high school. Afterward (despite us going on to the same college) we had had something of a falling out, pretty unambiguously caused by me asking her to date me and her not being interested. I'm not salty about that anymore by any means, but I remember observing as I walked along that, in a certain sense, she was dead to me: I still might occasionally think of her, but I had no expectation or desire to ever interact with her in any way for the rest of my life.

I got my food and drink to go, then started to walk back home. As is probably no surprise to the reader but was a pretty huge surprise to me, at an intersection, I crossed paths with that exact same girl and her brother (whom I had also not seen in years, although to be completely honest I never really gave a shit about him). We had a fairly amiable small-talk conversation, like you do when you run into someone unexpectedly, and then I went off to go eat my food and hopefully stop feeling physically ill (although I did feel a bit better just from walking).

When I got home and started eating, the unexpectedness (for me) grew even more, because she texted me, reframing her friendliness in our conversation as possibly genuine rather than just polite. She said to hit her up if I ever wanted to go run with her or something (we were both somewhat diligent runners in high school), and I cautiously replied likewise.

A few days later she actually did text me asking if I wanted to go run with her, and I did, and we're planning on running again tomorrow sometime. I'm gonna be honest, I think this whole thing is hilarious; I have no idea what's going on between us, and I'm not screwing around when I said that the same day we reconnected I thought about how she was dead to me. It's the kind of situation where there's just enough of a possibility that she wants to get with me now that it keeps me wondering, but it's certainly not enough to get my hopes up, seeing as this is the same girl who went to prom with me without wanting to date me. But I guess it somehow hadn't crossed my mind before this that it's kind of alright just to have her as a friend again.
